name: Hazel Dormouse
text: Skips its attacks, gaining +1/+1 each time, until it's hurt.
golden_text: Skips its attacks, gaining +2/+2 each time, until it's hurt.
details: It also wakes when no other unit of yours can attack.

source.note: Bide (Slumber): skips its attacks and gains +1/+1 this combat each time its side's order passes it, until it takes damage or no friendly unit that isn't waiting can attack.
